text: Indonesia's fires inspired us to connect satellite records.
Pyro Chronos. See the fire. Read the pattern.
Choose an area and dates. Explore NASA's open MODIS and VIIRS data.
Our prototype brings detections into calendars, comparisons, and traceable exports, with model limits made clear.
We envision better targeted field checks, stronger fire preparedness, and safer communities and ecosystems.
Pyro Chronos. From observations to informed action.
